meta.source: Written for the KERYX live operator console (Electron, Windows). Dark only.

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: The console's ground behind the modules and its 6px gutter between panels (.console overrides the gutter token's 8px). The top bar sits directly on it (no panel of its own). THE window is not on it: the window is one surface of bg-1.

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Every module (panel) surface. Lists sit on it; in the top bar, the search field and the Ver and bell chips; a folded panel's 28px strip.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised fields inside a panel: inputs, the search/command field, popovers and menus, hover tint of a row or glyph. Slide and verse rows sit on it.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected neutral state (a selected tab, an open menu trigger, an active segment of a neutral switch), the next slide's row, the drag ghost's card. The fourth and last grey step.

tokens.name: bg-4
tokens.usage: Only inside THE window's pages: the pressed or selected step of a panel there. The window is bg-1 and its panels one step up (bg-2, fields bg-3, pressed bg-4; console.css .win-body), so it reads raised over the console. fg-3 on it 4.6:1, never greyer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, the 1px separator between slide and verse rows, the line under a header's band, the 2px gap between Multiview quadrants. Decorative, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1px splitter line on hover, the hatch of an empty monitor. Never on something that floats (it glows on the dark ground). Never text.

tokens.name: line-overlay
tokens.usage: The one 1px ring of everything that floats: THE window, dialogs, the palette, the background library, menus and popovers (kx-pop), tooltips, toasts, the dragged card. Darker than line; the shadow gives the depth.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: line at 60 %: the lines inside what floats — menu separators, the window's bar, the Configurações nav and groups, a dialog's header and footer, the library's side and footer.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Content text (13–14px) and labels of the row in hand on bg-1, bg-2 and bg-3. 15.9:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: UI labels (12px), glyphs at rest, clock digits. 7.2:1 on bg-3.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata (11px), section headers, placeholder text, done items of the Setlist, and the quiet 1px focus line of a field (5.5:1 on bg-2; text fields never get the gold ring). 4.9:1 on bg-3 — never go greyer than this for text.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: AO VIVO everywhere (green = AO VIVO, gold = SELECIONADO (the Prévia), grey = PRÓXIMO, red only alerts and Encerrar; no left bars, the state is a light wash plus a 1px ring of its colour.): the dot of the Programa's pill, the ring of a row, a Bíblia cell or a slide on air, the frame of a monitor on air. 5.8:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: air-fg
tokens.usage: Green text of the on-air state on bg-1/bg-2: an on-air row's title, a cell's number, 'NO AR AGORA'. 9.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: air-fill
tokens.usage: Red fills (danger, not a state): the Encerrar and Excluir buttons (kx-btn-air) and the 'drop to send' hint over the Programa while a library row is dragged there. Text on it is on-state (white, 5.0:1); hover and pressed step darker (air-fill-hover, air-fill-pressed).

tokens.name: air-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a red fill button (Encerrar, Excluir…). Darker, never lighter: white on it 5.9:1.

tokens.name: air-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed red fill button. White on it 7.3:1.

tokens.name: air-tint
tokens.usage: 16% green wash behind an on-air list row or Bíblia cell, always with its 1px ring (--air-ring). Never alone.

tokens.name: prev
tokens.usage: SELECIONADO (the Prévia): the frame of the Prévia monitor, the ring of a selected row, slide, verse or cell. The brand's gold as a state. 5.5:1 on bg-3.

tokens.name: prev-fg
tokens.usage: Gold text of the selected state on bg-1/bg-2: the Prévia's badge, a selected row's title, a selected cell's number. 10.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: prev-fill
tokens.usage: Green fills: 'Enviar ao ar' where it exists (Bíblia, Escola bíblica, Mídia): green because it puts something on air. Text on it is on-state (white, 5.1:1); hover and pressed step darker.

tokens.name: prev-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on 'Enviar ao ar' (kx-btn-prev). Darker, never lighter (a lighter green, or prev itself at 3.2:1, takes white under 4.5:1): white on it 6.0:1.

tokens.name: prev-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed 'Enviar ao ar'. White on it 7.4:1.

tokens.name: prev-tint
tokens.usage: 16% gold wash behind a selected list row or Bíblia cell, always with its 1px ring (--prev-ring).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: AO VIVO in the slide lists (the Slides column, No ar, the Bíblia's verses): the same green as everywhere.

tokens.name: live-fg
tokens.usage: Green text of the on-air state where it is a word (Sincronizar's 'agora', the marker on air).

tokens.name: live-bg
tokens.usage: The on-air wash of a slide or verse row (16 % green over bg-2), with its ring (--live-ring). Darker than the selected one, so the two differ in lightness, not only in hue (src/lib/stateColors.test.mjs). Labels fg-2, numbers fg-1.

tokens.name: prev-bg
tokens.usage: The selected (Prévia) wash of a slide or verse row (34 % gold over bg-2), with its ring (--prev-ring); its labels and numbers are fg-1 (fg-2 is 4.3:1 there). A row on air and selected at once takes this wash, the green ring and the green number chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: ALERT (red; never a state): the bell's dot, a refused import row, the Encerrar glyph of the pills, the player's eye while a video plays as sound only. 4.7:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Red text of an alert on bg-1/bg-2. 6.5:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: OK / DONE / CONNECTED (green, not the on-air state): an output 'Conectada', a sync that is fine, an update or upload bar, a step done, a correct answer. 5.8:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: ok-fg
tokens.usage: Green text of OK on bg-1/bg-2: 'Conectada', 'Relato enviado'. 9.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: 10% green wash behind an OK result (a report sent, an open edition's licence chip).

tokens.name: verse-pressed
tokens.usage: A verse card pressed: one step past its hover (bg-3), so the hand sees the press before the click prepares it.

tokens.name: sel-bg
tokens.usage: MARKED (several items selected, multiSelect.js): the wash of a marked list row. The blue of Travado, never the Prévia's green or the air's gold, so a row can be marked and in the Prévia or on air and still read as both.

tokens.name: sel-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px inset ring of a marked row, and the 2px ring of a marked gallery tile (with rh-fg).

tokens.name: rh
tokens.usage: LOCKED (Travar telas): nothing new goes to the screens. The dot of the Programa's pill and its frame while locked, the banner's top rule, the output status dot. 5.0:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: rh-fg
tokens.usage: Blue text on bg-1/bg-2: the 'TELAS TRAVADAS' banner text, 'Travado' in the Programa's pill, 'Prévia · travado' on the Prévia's badge. 8.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: rh-fill
tokens.usage: 'Destravar' on the lock banner (24px, like every banner button). Text on it is on-state (white, 4.7:1); hover and pressed step darker.

tokens.name: rh-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on 'Destravar' (kx-btn-rh). Darker, never lighter: white on it 5.6:1.

tokens.name: rh-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed 'Destravar'. White on it 6.9:1.

tokens.name: rh-tint
tokens.usage: 10% blue wash of the lock banner.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: WARNING or FAILURE: output reconnecting or disconnected, missing file, font not installed, a theme with no background, an edition from the internet. Dots, hatches, the 2px bar, the Programa's frame on a failure. 9.0:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: Amber text on bg-1/bg-2: 'Reconectando… tentativa 2', 'Arquivo não encontrado', the Saídas status with a problem. 11.5:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: 10% amber wash of the recovery banner and the reconnecting hatch (alternated with bg-0 stripes).

tokens.name: on-state
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on air-fill, prev-fill and rh-fill. Never on bg-1/bg-2 (use fg-1).

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill (the amber PiP label 'Reconectando', the 'sem fundo' mark). 9.1:1 on warn.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The KERYX gold: the logo mark, the underline of the environment on screen (KERYX | BÍBLIA), the 2px focus ring of controls (never of a text field), the fill of ordinary primary actions such as Salvar or Novo culto (kx-btn-brand), and the slide or verse ON AIR in the Slides column, No ar and the Bíblia's lists (--live, its wash --live-bg). 5.5:1 on bg-3. Never the Programa's pill, the Prévia, Enviar ao ar, a locked state or a warning; one or two gold cues per region.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a gold button.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed gold button (on-brand on it: 4.7:1). Never text on bg-2/bg-3.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: 10% gold wash, very sparse: behind the item chosen for editing, an empty Temas slot on hover, with a gold edge.

tokens.name: brand-gradient
tokens.usage: The brand's gold glow, laid over bg-0: the opening window (electron/splash.html, which copies it). Nowhere in the console.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on brand fills: the gold button's label, the logo mark's K. 6.7:1 on brand.

tokens.name: screen-bg
tokens.usage: The black of a projected screen: Tela preta, the ground behind a background image, the letterbox of a monitor.

tokens.name: chrome-on-screen
tokens.usage: bg-0 at 85 %: what the console lays over a monitor's picture — the Programa's and the Prévia's pills, the Prévia's badge, the kind mark of a thumbnail, the dark stripes of the hatch. Reads on any slide.

tokens.name: chrome-ring
tokens.usage: White at 8 %: the 1px ring of chrome-on-screen, so the pill and the badge hold their edge on a black slide.

tokens.name: chrome-sep
tokens.usage: A separator inside the chrome over a screen: the 1px lines between the groups of a pill's buttons.

tokens.name: chrome-hover
tokens.usage: A glyph button inside the chrome over a screen under the pointer (the pill's Tela preta, Logo, Limpar…).

tokens.name: chrome-pressed
tokens.usage: The same button pressed: it answers the hand at once.

tokens.name: chrome-label
tokens.usage: A small label over a thumbnail (the song editor's slide number, part and fit; the Multiview's quadrant name and number): a little more see-through than a pill.

tokens.name: chrome-mark
tokens.usage: A warning mark over a picture (a theme saved without a background: 'sem fundo').

tokens.name: scrim-dim
tokens.usage: The dim backdrop under a dialog that holds the console (the palette, Encerrar, Primeiros passos): bg-0 at 60 %.

tokens.name: swatch-ring
tokens.usage: The faint light ring around a colour swatch, so a dark colour still shows its edge on bg-2.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: The same ring around the background library's colour tiles.

tokens.name: qr-ground
tokens.usage: The white ground behind a QR code, so a phone's camera reads it (Telas na rede, the controle remoto).

tokens.name: specimen-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of a font specimen (Fontes do computador): near the projector's black, so the letters read as they will on a screen.

tokens.name: standin-camera
tokens.usage: The stand-in camera picture behind Transmissão's preview, so its lower third is seen over something like video.

tokens.name: stage-label
tokens.usage: A label over Sincronizar's stage (where the marks come from).

tokens.name: stage-now
tokens.usage: The time chip over Sincronizar's stage.

tokens.name: screen-fg
tokens.usage: Projected text: lyrics, verses, announcements on a background image, with the screen-text shadow.

scale.note: The console's seven sizes. Every font-size in console.css and bundle.css is one of these (src/lib/tokens.test.mjs; the logo's K, a font specimen and the church's code are the documented exceptions). The projected screens size in cqw and are not on this scale.

tokens.name: fs-meta
tokens.usage: meta and section: telemetry, counts, times, uppercase section heads, the labels over a thumbnail. The smallest text on the console.

tokens.name: fs-ui
tokens.usage: ui and live-cap: buttons, tabs, menu items, inputs, a monitor's state word.

tokens.name: fs-content
tokens.usage: content and alert-title: titles in lists, dialogs' text, the menu bar.

tokens.name: fs-content-lg
tokens.usage: content-lg and next-title: slide text in the Slides column, Bible verses.

tokens.name: fs-live
tokens.usage: live-title: what is on air where a monitor carries a caption; the quick jump's field; a font's name in its dialog.

tokens.name: fs-clock
tokens.usage: clock: the clocks and the figures of the player and the timers.

tokens.name: fs-count
tokens.usage: countdown: a countdown inside the console.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Telemetry only: the grey line under a title, timestamps, counts, key, length, tooltips' shortcut. Never the name of what is on air or prepared (live-title, next-title). Always fg-3 or fg-2, always tabular numerals.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Module and section headers, uppercase, fg-3; a folded strip's standing name. A listhead never repeats the page title.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, menu items, inputs, the top bar. fg-2 at rest, fg-1 when the control is the one in hand.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside UI text: the status label, the active segment of a switch, the primary button's label.

styles.name: content
styles.usage: Titles in lists: songs, media, Setlist items, layers. fg-1.

styles.name: content-lg
styles.sample: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira…
styles.usage: Reading text: slide text in the Slides column, Bible verses in the reading view. One line per lyric line (ending in '…' when too long); verses wrap. The largest size on the console except clocks.

styles.name: live-cap
styles.usage: A monitor's state word (the Prévia's badge: 'Prévia', 'Prévia · travado'), in the state's text colour (prev-fg, rh-fg). The Programa has no state word: its pill's dot says it.

styles.name: live-title
styles.usage: What is on air, once per screen, where a monitor carries a caption. fg-1.

styles.name: next-title
styles.usage: What is prepared, where a monitor carries a caption. fg-1.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: What failed, in an output banner. The state's text colour.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The clocks in the top bar and the figures of the player and the timers. Tabular numerals, fg-2.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Countdowns and timers inside the console (never on the console for anything else). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: screen-lyrics
styles.sample: Tua voz me chama pelo nome
styles.usage: Lyrics on the projected 1920×1080 screen (scaled by the monitor: 5.2% of the screen width). screen-fg with the screen-text shadow.

styles.name: screen-verse
styles.sample: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira…
styles.usage: Bible text on screen; the reference line beneath it uses screen-ref.

styles.name: screen-ref
styles.usage: The reference under a projected passage and the song title on the first slide. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Gap between a glyph and its label, between stacked rows of metadata.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a row and a control; the gap between a panel header's controls (8px, as in the windows' bar).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A panel header's text and last button from the panel's edge; padding of a popover or menu.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a dialog body; the width of an icon glyph.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state inset; vertical rhythm inside the brand book only.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The token's 8px; the console overrides it to 6px (.console --gutter) — one gap between every container, and a splitter IS the gap (never a second gap beside one). Also the inset of the grid from the window edge.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of rows, controls and tabs; a band's controls. Panel headers have their own (panel-head).

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: List rows in the Confortável density (Ver › Densidade): 14px titles, up to two lines. Compacta keeps row (28px). The default, Automática, is Compacta on a grid under 820px tall, else Confortável.

tokens.name: panel-head
tokens.usage: A panel's header: title and controls (control-sm, 24px) centred with 6px above and below, so the 14px corner never crowds them. Compacta takes panel-head-compact (console.css .is-compact; layout.js panelHead keeps the dock's locked heights in step).

tokens.name: panel-head-compact
tokens.usage: A panel's header in Compacta (a notebook): 4px less than panel-head.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar (it sits on bg-0, without a panel).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: A small control: a panel header's buttons, selects and Seg (8px apart, as in the windows' bar), a row's hover buttons, the pills' buttons, chips, the dock's tabs.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: A band under a header (the Mídia's bar and its selection bar, the internet lyrics' search): its controls are row (28px), 4px in and 4px apart.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Width of the state bar on a list row's left edge (not on slide and verse rows) and of the focus ring of a control.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, list-row cards (inset 4px, 2px apart), timeline blocks, the monitor's inner screen.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Modules, popovers, menus, dialogs, THE window, banners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: State dots (6px), the seek handle of the player, the Programa's pill and the top bar's search field and chips.

shadow.note: The console has no shadows inside panels. Popovers that float over the grid get one hairline-plus-ambient shadow so they separate from the module under them; projected text gets a text shadow for legibility on any background.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Small floaters that ride the grid: tooltips, the toast, the Camadas drawer, drag ghosts. The ring is line-overlay; menus keep it with a deeper shadow (console .kx-pop).

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Floating dialogs over the console (the background library, ConfirmDialog, the palette): the line-overlay ring with a lighter, shorter shadow. THE window has its own, deeper (shadow-window).

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: THE window over the console: a fainter ring than line-overlay and a deep, two-layer shadow, so the one bg-1 surface lifts off the console behind it. Detached (/Janela) it has none.

tokens.name: live-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px green ring of a slide, verse, row or cell on air (no left bars: the state is the wash plus this ring).

tokens.name: prev-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px gold ring of what is selected (the Prévia).

tokens.name: brand-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px gold border all round the edit banner (Editando a disposição), in place of a top rule.

tokens.name: warn-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px amber border all round an alert banner (an output that failed) and the Aviso rápido on air.

tokens.name: rh-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px blue border all round the Telas travadas banner.

tokens.name: next-ring
tokens.usage: The 1px grey ring of the next slide: no colour of state, it only says 'é o próximo'.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Every menu and popover (kx-pop in the console): the line-overlay ring and a deeper shadow than a tooltip's.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: The card that follows the pointer while a list row is dragged: lifted.

tokens.name: shadow-drag-land
tokens.usage: The same card settling into its slot.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The player's seek handle over its bar.

tokens.name: shadow-peek
tokens.usage: The picture the player's seek bar shows under the pointer (a frame or a cover).

tokens.name: stage-text
tokens.usage: A text-shadow: the line Sincronizar plays over its stage.

tokens.name: screen-text
tokens.usage: A text-shadow (not a box-shadow) under projected lyrics and verses so screen-fg reads on bright backgrounds.

timing.note: One easing, one fast duration. Hover, focus, selection and state changes transition background-color, color, border-color and opacity over 120ms ease-out. Motion with a purpose: a panel fold and No ar folding away take 180ms, rows gliding and the card settling while dragging a list 180ms, THE window easing between its sizes. Projected screens use the theme's slide transition and fade out on Esc, Limpar, Tela preta and Logo (Configurações › Telas e saídas › Transições). prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes the console's transitions (outputs ignore it).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, selection and state changes on the console.

tokens.name: dur-fold
tokens.usage: A panel folding or opening, No ar coming and going, a Configurações group, a chevron turning (Dock.jsx useDockEase reads it).

tokens.name: ease-fold
tokens.usage: The fold's curve: quick out, soft landing. Also a disclosure's chevron.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The console's easing for hover, state changes and dragging in a list.

layer.note: Every z-index on the console is one of these names (src/lib/tokens.test.mjs). Inside a box that is its own stacking context (a monitor's screen, a thumbnail, THE window, a splitter) only that box's steps compare, screen to ring. The console's floaters stack above all of them, scrim to drag. Never a raw number: a new layer is a name here, by its role.

tokens.name: z-screen
tokens.usage: The first step over what a box draws: a submenu over its menu's rows, a list's drop slot, a sticky header, the network page in its card, Sincronizar's marks.

tokens.name: z-mark
tokens.usage: A mark over a picture or a header: the 'sem fundo' mark, the PiP's caption, a sticky bar over a sticky header, Sincronizar's playhead, the splitter over its neighbours.

tokens.name: z-handle
tokens.usage: A handle over a mark: the splitter's % badge while editing the arrangement.

tokens.name: z-edge
tokens.usage: THE window's resize edges over its page; the screen editor's overlay over its canvas.

tokens.name: z-guide
tokens.usage: The top step inside a box: the screen editor's snap guides, an alert band over a demo screen.

tokens.name: z-hatch
tokens.usage: A monitor's hatch (a file missing or coming, a PDF preparing) over the picture.

tokens.name: z-frame
tokens.usage: A monitor's 1px state frame (::after), over the hatch.

tokens.name: z-badge
tokens.usage: Over the frame: the Prévia's badge, the Multiview's labels, the 'não vai mostrar' lines, a thumbnail's labels.

tokens.name: z-drop
tokens.usage: The drop hint over a monitor while a library row is dragged there.

tokens.name: z-pill
tokens.usage: The Programa's and the Prévia's pills: over everything else on the screen; they take the clicks.

tokens.name: z-ring
tokens.usage: A thumbnail's selection ring (the song editor's slides), over its labels.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: The clear backdrop of an open popover, over the console's panels.

tokens.name: z-menubar
tokens.usage: The menu bar over the popover's backdrop, so pointing at another menu switches.

tokens.name: z-window-scrim
tokens.usage: THE window's dim backdrop, over the console and the menu bar.

tokens.name: z-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers from the top bar and the panels (Ver, Saídas, the bell, the menu bar's menus, the tabs lists, Voltar ao anterior), the player's seek tip. Never open with THE window: the console behind it is inert and the menu keys are off.

tokens.name: z-window
tokens.usage: THE window (Configurações, the editors, every page).

tokens.name: z-window-over
tokens.usage: A popover's backdrop opened over THE window.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: The Camadas drawer from the Programa's pill.

tokens.name: z-verify
tokens.usage: Verificar tudo, over the console.

tokens.name: z-library-scrim
tokens.usage: The background library's backdrop, over THE window.

tokens.name: z-library
tokens.usage: The background library, a picker that answers: over THE window.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs: the palette, Encerrar, Primeiros passos, Atalhos, the internet lyrics, the Bíblia's quick jump.

tokens.name: z-confirm-scrim
tokens.usage: ConfirmDialog's backdrop, over a dialog and the library.

tokens.name: z-confirm
tokens.usage: ConfirmDialog (Excluir…, Descartar as mudanças?); the Biblioteca's video peek at the same step.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus from a button (the (+) menus, the Bíblia's lists), the right-click menu's backdrop, the dock's drop hint while arranging.

tokens.name: z-menu-top
tokens.usage: The right-click menu over its backdrop; the dock's dragged module.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: The toast (Desfazer): over every menu and dialog.

tokens.name: z-drag
tokens.usage: The card that follows the pointer while a list row is dragged (on <body>).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Done items of the Setlist, hidden layers, a disabled control, the inert fold chevron. Applied to the whole row, text included.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: The amber hatch over a monitor whose output is reconnecting: the stripes let the last frame show through.
